one_line: The NAICS and small-business set-aside fit us, but USACE plans to send the RFQ to only 3 offerors and mobilization starts in 6 days. We should email the CO by 11/19 asking to get the RFQ, and quote only if we can get a furnished 24' x 60' office trailer to Winfield, MO, with power connected, by December 1.
scope: USACE St. Louis District wants a furnished 24' x 60' mobile office trailer with four private offices, two stair sets, and skirting. It must have furniture for 12 people, a 12-seat conference room with a 60-inch monitor and whiteboard, and kitchen appliances, plus one accessible and one standard portable toilet with weekly pumping, all at Lock and Dam 25 in Winfield, MO. The contractor also coordinates temporary power and a meter with Ameren Missouri and makes all physical connections from the meter to the trailer. It is a firm-fixed-price monthly rental: a 6-month base period (Dec 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027) plus two 3-month options.
fit: NAICS 532490 is in our NAICS list, and we hold GSA SIN 532490P.
Total Small Business Set-Aside: we are an SBE, our SAM registration is active (UEI REVFD44JLMV5, CAGE 57C31), and the synopsis requires active SAM.
Our fleet includes office and classroom trailers, and 'portable sanitation' is one of our core competencies (Facility Support & Utilities).
We already run weekly servicing (sanitizing, gray/black water removal, consumables), which lines up with the weekly pumping and sanitation requirement.

Relevant federal/DoD past performance: USCG Station Lake Worth Inlet ($78,500), Portsmouth Naval Shipyard equipment rental and maintenance (~$130,000), Camp Lejeune via ECC ($239,760), and Fort Lee basecamp ($408,482). Denver restroom trailer service includes pump-outs.
Our work area is nationwide, and we claim deployment within 24–72 hours of award.
red_flags: Closed competition: USACE 'will be issuing RFQ to 3 offerors.' The notice is only the public posting the RFO Part 5 rule requires, so the three offerors are probably already chosen.
Very tight schedule: site access for mobilization starts Nov 20, 2026 (6 days from today), and everything must be operational on Dec 1, 2026. Award would have to happen almost right away.
Billing starts only after the unit is delivered, fully furnished, electrically connected, and fully operational. Any delay with Ameren Missouri or delivery is unpaid time.

The scope is mostly an office trailer plus office furniture, AV, and appliances. That is outside our core life-support work, and nothing on file shows we have a 24' x 60' four-office unit or office furniture inventory.
Electrical work from the meter to the trailer probably needs a licensed electrician in Missouri. Utility lead times could miss Dec 1.
We list no Missouri or Midwest depot. The portable toilets and weekly pumping would probably need a local subcontractor.
PSC W054 (prefabricated and portable buildings) is not one of our PSC codes (W023, W099, W045).
Our price list has no line for office trailers, portable toilets, furniture, or delivery to Missouri, so we have no internal pricing basis.
There is an incumbent on site: Acceleron, W912P925P0005, with a period through 05/30/27.
Repairing or replacing broken items costs the Government nothing extra, so that risk is ours for the full term.
competition: The incumbent is Acceleron: W912P925P0005, $117,484, trailer rental at the same USACE St. Louis District location, 11/05/24 – 05/30/27 (per the HigherGov analysis). This agency has made no other office-trailer awards under NAICS 532490. The closest is EquipmentShare's Lock and Dam 25 dewatering equipment award ($1,335,321, 2 offers). Benchmarks from other agencies: Williams Scotsman wins office trailer leases often (Yuma $146,238, 4 offers; Dugway $349,238, 11 offers; Providence $56,076, 1 offer). Monmouth Solutions won a small-business set-aside mobile office trailer award against 8 offers. The RFQ is limited to 3 offerors, and none are named.
price_signal: USACE's estimated value is $90,000–$180,000. The incumbent (Acceleron) got $117,484 for trailer rental at this site, a longer period whose scope may differ. Comparable awards: Monmouth Solutions, Red Rock Mobile Office Trailer, $131,670 (small-business set-aside, 8 offers, PoP 9/2024–3/2027). Williams Scotsman, Yuma office trailers, $146,238 (4 offers, ~11 months). Valcorp, trailer lease, $173,135 (8(a) sole source, 2 years). Williams Scotsman, Lease of Trailer 38, $56,076 (~9 months). Nazareth, portable offices, $55,217 (~5 weeks). Our price list has no office trailer, portable toilet, or furniture rates: [CONFIRM: pricing basis].

Firm-fixed-price commercial services contract (Synopsis, Type of Proposed Contract)
Site access Nov 20, 2026; fully operational and ready for occupancy Dec 1, 2026; base period Dec 1, 2026 – May 31, 2027 plus two 3-month options (Synopsis, Period of Performance)
24' x 60' trailer with four private offices, two complete sets of access stairs, and perimeter skirting (Synopsis SOW 1)
Calendar-month billing that starts only after the unit is delivered, furnished, electrically connected, and operational; repair or replacement of broken items at no additional cost (Synopsis SOW 1)
One handicap-accessible and one standard portable toilet, weekly pumping and sanitation, hand sanitizer in the trailer and both toilets, placement coordinated with the COR (Synopsis SOW 2)

Commercial-grade furniture for 12: workstations, 12 ergonomic chairs (adjustable height, lumbar support), a small filing cabinet per workstation, lighting, outlets, and commercial HVAC sized for 12 (Synopsis SOW 3)
Conference package: rectangular table seating 12, separate chairs, wall-mounted 60-inch monitor, wall-mounted or mobile whiteboard (Synopsis SOW 3)
Top-freezer refrigerator of at least 18 cu ft, kitchen break table, commercial microwave, industrial-capacity coffee maker (Synopsis SOW 4)

Coordinate with Ameren Missouri for temporary power from the existing riser pole and a meter for a separate USACE account; contractor makes all physical connections from the meter or service drop to the trailer (Synopsis SOW 5)
Comply with installation access control, FPCON, RAM, and HPCON; NCIC-III and TSDB vetting for unescorted access (Synopsis SOW 6)
DoD/Army security awareness training within 30 days of award or performance start; documentation within 5 business days of completion (Synopsis SOW 6)
E-Verify under FAR 52.222-54; initial candidate verification list to the COR within 3 business days of award (Synopsis SOW 6)
